description: This file defines the AppTypography class in Dart, which provides a method to generate a customized TextTheme for styling text widgets in a Flutter application. It customizes various text styles like displayLarge, titleLarge, titleMedium, etc., using color and font weight modifications.

classes.name: AppTypography
classes.description: A utility class providing a method to generate customized text themes consistent with the app's stylistic branding.

methods.name: textTheme
methods.description: Returns a styled TextTheme based on the current theme, with specific customizations for various text styles such as displayLarge, titleLarge, etc.
